name: 36083 · Tuskegee, AL
findings: ZIP 36083 (Tuskegee) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36083 (Tuskegee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36083 (Tuskegee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.9 times the typical level).
